question: Do fitting-only causal moment, arc-residual, exact-level occupancy, event-dominance, and dwell features improve a strong from-scratch H512x1 GRU over the same raw/event GRU with the feature suffix zeroed?
verification_tier: B: paired training seeds and component-level resampling on exposed cross-validation folds
primary_outcome: Equal-weight mean across four folds of paired differences in global_wp_clip2_v1 at fixed epoch 2; each model's official metric pools all scored rows in its fold.
practical_effect_note: A +0.001 absolute WP improvement is a useful effect to pursue, not a kill threshold. Preserve uncertain or negative results for combinations and representation changes.

comparator.features: 112 raw columns plus canonical event features; 60 geometry/discrete suffix columns all zero
comparator.capacity_control: Same model input width, parameter initialization, architecture, data order, optimizer, schedule, and training budget as treatment. The suffix is zeroed only in the comparator.

treatment.features: Same raw/event inputs plus 60 causal geometry/discrete channels
treatment.prior: Refit deterministically per seed from up to 64 source-qualified fitting sequences only; both arms build the same prior and the comparator masks all 60 channels.

data.membership: All fit groups in each frozen CampaignSplit fold; evaluation-linked components are excluded by the trainer.
data.exposure: Fold 0/1 were used in earlier geometry experiments. Treat all four folds as exposed or potentially exposed development data; this is not pristine confirmation.

paired_repetitions.arm_order: control first for even pair indices, feature first for odd pair indices
paired_repetitions.pairing: Same fold and seed for both arms; verify equal initial_parameter_sha256 in saved provenance.
paired_repetitions.stopping: Complete all 30 pairs regardless of interim scores; stop only for a concrete execution/resource fault, then diagnose and preserve evidence.

training.evaluation_protocol: CampaignSplit runs use --no-eval-during-fit; after the fixed epoch-2 checkpoint is written, scripts/predict_run.py predicts only the manifest's component-held-out evaluation_groups and the official global_wp_clip2_v1 grader scores them. Training-time validation metrics are not used for the primary outcome.
training.resume: --save-training-state writes an atomic continuation state at every epoch boundary; the matrix runner resumes incomplete fits from that state and preserves every completed endpoint.
training.initialization: new seeded weights; no checkpoint, teacher, or initializer
diagnostics: gradient norm quantiles and clipping rate

compute.device: one local NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU
compute.cpu_quota: one core for this task, within the two-core campaign parent
compute.ram_max: 5,000,000,000 bytes (~4.66 GiB) hard cap for this task, no swap; no array staging
compute.profile: Passed five measured training batches after one warmup batch, plus feature-only prediction over all 468 fold-0 evaluation groups. The measured profile used a 5,000,000,000-byte/one-core/no-swap scope: 2.71 GB cgroup peak, 0.91 GB CUDA allocated peak, 1.29 GB CUDA reserved peak, 1.53 s median wall time per batch of eight 20,000-row sequences, 5.24 sequences/s, 60/60 finite optimizer updates and no new OOM events. Estimated matrix training time is about 114 GPU-hours before setup and evaluation exports; finish all 30 pairs regardless of interim scores.

significance.training_variation: Report all 30 paired deltas and a fold-stratified paired bootstrap 95% interval over seed-pairs.
significance.evaluation_sampling: Report component-cluster bootstrap uncertainty on fixed predictions separately; when feasible, combine resampling of pair IDs and components without treating rows or seeds as independent components.
significance.selection: One preregistered model/configuration and fixed epoch; no best-seed selection. Exposed folds remain development evidence.
significance.interpretation: Report effect size, both intervals, per-fold and per-seed deltas, and practical size. An interval crossing zero is inconclusive, not a universal reason to stop the family.

artifacts: Per-fit command and complete stdout log
Checkpoint, optimizer/scheduler continuation state, and provenance
Fixed-checkpoint predictions and source row-group IDs; targets and masks are read from the hash-bound valid_targets.npz rather than duplicated per fit
Official global_wp_clip2_v1 score receipt for every endpoint
Append-only per-fit and resource ledgers from scripts/run_geometry_r4_matrix.py
limits: Cross-validation folds are exposed or potentially exposed and overlap in training membership.
This main-effect comparison does not settle whether the features help a teacher, distillation, residual, or fixed blend.
The research-only feature mode has no streaming submission implementation; do not package it as a submission until serving parity and runtime are validated.
No public score forecast follows from local deltas.
